The '''865th''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] unit. Their unit patch was a stylized lightning bolt forking in three directions. [[Elbren BaChorin]] served as the unit's [[Flight Commander/Legends|Flight Commander]].
